info.title: Jimmy AI OpenAPI
info.description: API for Jimmy AI video generation services

post.description: Create a new video generation task using Sora models. Route 1 (route1): model sora2-12s, duration must be 12. Route 3: sora2-gz-stable / sora2-gz-sp. Route 6: see model config.

get.description: Query the status and result of a video generation task.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: The ID of the task to query

post.description: Create an async GPT Image 2 image task (model=gpt-image-2). The same path also supports gpt-image-1.5, nano-banana family, doubao-seedream-5-0-pro, etc. See each model page. Recommended for production to avoid 504 timeouts on sync calls behind Cloudflare.

get.description: Query the status and result of an image generation task.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: The ID of the task to query

post.description: Understand and analyze uploaded images based on the Gemini 3.5 Flash model (supports e-commerce promotion analysis, etc.).
Synchronous background removal. Charges immediately on success (billing model viraltok-remove-bg) and returns b64_json by default; pass response_format=url for image_url.

Synchronous text-to-image, compatible with OpenAI POST /v1/images/generations. Billed on success; returns image results in data without polling. Direct image endpoint: https://img.viraltok.ai. If sync calls hit 504 (often Cloudflare proxy timeout), prefer async image task creation.

Synchronous image edit, compatible with OpenAI POST /v1/images/edits. Upload source images via multipart/form-data (multiple files supported, all using field name `image`); billed on success. Direct image endpoint: https://img.viraltok.ai. If sync calls hit 504 (often Cloudflare proxy timeout), prefer async image task creation.

Create a VEO video task. model supports veo_3_1_fast (Fast) or veo_3_1_lite (Lite). Fast: 720p/1080p bill veo_3_1_fast, 4k bills veo_3_1_fast-4k. Lite: 720p only, bills veo_3_1_lite (per task). Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId}.

Create a Seedance 2.0 video task. Routes: Full/Manxue (sd2_mx_*, per-second, assets require audit), SP economy (seedance2.0-sp / seedance2.0-fast-sp, per-second by resolution, 720p/1080p only, 480p not supported), SP official (seedance2.0-of-sp / seedance2.0-of-fast-sp, per-second by resolution), Mini (seedance2.0-mini, per-second by resolution), MD (seedance2.0-md / seedance2.0-fast-md / seedance2.0-pro / seedance2.0-fast-pro, per-task, 720p; Pro supports up to 9 images and 3 audios, no reference videos), Fast I2V (seedance2.0-fast-i2v, per-task, 720p, image refs only, max 9, no reference video/audio), STD standard (seedance2.0-std, per-task, 720p, supports audio references). Seedance 2.0 933 (seedance2.0-933, per-second by resolution 480p/720p/1080p; optional reference_images/videos/audios, face_processing, generate_audio, reference_mode). Seedance 2.0 GZ 720p (seedance2.0-gz-720p, per-second, fixed 720p; optional images/videos/audios; direct result media URL). Seedance 933 720p (sd2-933-720p, per-second 0.0479/s, fixed 720p; optional images/videos/audios, reference_mode, generate_audio). Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId} for results. See seedance/md/create, seedance/md/fast-i2v, seedance/md/std, seedance/mini/create for details.
Submit raw asset URL lists (videos, images, or audios) for Seedance 2.0 moderation.
Query moderation status and details of submitted Seedance assets.
Upload image, video, audio, or text assets to the Seedance SP economy library. Returns asset_id for asset:// references.
Query processing status and metadata for a single Seedance SP asset.
Batch query processing status for Seedance SP assets.
Create a Gemini Omni video generation task. After the task is created, use the common video task query endpoint to retrieve status and results.
Create a Grok 1.5 video generation task. Once created, use the common query task endpoint to get task details.

Create a MiniMax H3 video generation task. Supports text prompt, up to 5 reference images, 1 reference audio, optional first/last frames, duration 5-15s, and aspect_ratio/size. Billed per_task (flat per request; duration does not affect cost). Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId} for results.

value.prompt: A cinematic product shot with natural lighting

post.description: Create a Kling O3 video generation task. Supports text prompt, up to 3 reference images, optional first/last frames, duration 3-15s, aspect_ratio 16:9/9:16/1:1, resolution 720p/1080p, and optional audio. Billed per_task (flat per request; duration does not affect cost). Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId} for results.

value.prompt: A cinematic product shot with natural lighting

post.description: Enhance a publicly accessible video to higher resolution. Clarity and FPS are selected via model. Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId} for results. Billed per second with duration ceiled up.

Submit a digital-human lip-sync video task from a face video and driving audio. Optional model_version, side_face, and tilted_face. Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId} for results. Billed per second based on ceiled video_url duration.
Submit a video subtitle-removal task with a public video URL. Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId} for results. Billed per second based on ceiled video_url duration.
Submit a voice-cloning preview task. Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/audios/{id} for modelId and preview audioUrl.

value.contentText: A short preview sentence for voice cloning.

post.description: Generate production audio using modelId from a completed preview task.

value.contentText: Welcome to voice cloning. This is production audio text.

get.description: Query preview or production SoundClone task status and results.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Task ID from create preview or create audio

get.description: Returns the JimiCoin account balance for the user who owns the API key (total balance, net consumption, available balance). used_coin is account-wide consumption minus refunds across all keys. OpenAPI usage is billed against this account.

Returns quota usage for the current API key (total, used, remaining). total_quota of 0 means unlimited. used_quota is cumulative billed OpenAPI cost for this key only; unlike /user/balance used_coin (account-wide net consumption).

post.description: Upload an image, video, or audio file and receive a publicly accessible URL. Maximum file size is 100 MB.
Gemini video understanding. Pass inline base64 video in contents, or video_url for server-side download (max 80MB). Default model: gemini-3.1-flash-lite.

Create a Seedance 2.5 video generation task. Standard seedance-2.5: up to 30 reference images, 10 reference videos (each and total ≤30.2s), 10 audios (each ≤30s), duration 4–30s, resolution 480p/720p, billed per_second by resolution (seedance-2.5-480p / seedance-2.5-720p). SP seedance-2.5-sp: flat 0.5/s, 720p only, duration 4–30s, same media limits, optional first_image / last_image. Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId}.

value.prompt: A cinematic product shot with natural lighting

post.description: Create a Flux 3 video task. Only 6 models: flux-3-draft / flux-3-i2v-draft / flux-3-flf-draft / flux-3-keyframes-draft / flux-3-extend-draft (fixed 720p) and flux-3-enhance (fixed 1080p). Do not send resolution. Billing model equals request model, per_second × duration (5–20s). Draft returns result.draft_cache_url. Poll GET /api/open-api/v1/videos/{taskId}.

value.prompt: A red panda walks along a mossy log

model.description: Model name. Route 1: sora2-12s (duration must be 12). Route 3: sora2-gz-stable, sora2-gz-sp, etc.

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Route 1 sora2-12s must be 12

model.description: Model name. Manxue: sd2_mx_720p | sd2_mx_1080p | sd2_mx_2k | sd2_mx_4k; Fast: sd2_mx_fast_720p | sd2_mx_fast_1080p; Video ref: sd2_mx_video_720p | sd2_mx_video_1080p | sd2_mx_video_2k | sd2_mx_video_4k; Video ref Fast: sd2_mx_video_fast_720p | sd2_mx_video_fast_1080p (all per-second). reference_videos only for video-series models. SP economy: seedance2.0-sp | seedance2.0-fast-sp (per-second by resolution, 720p/1080p, 480p not supported). SP official: seedance2.0-of-sp | seedance2.0-of-fast-sp (per-second by resolution). Mini: seedance2.0-mini (per-second by resolution; billing names like seedance2.0-mini-720p / seedance2.0-mini-720p-video also accepted). MD: seedance2.0-md (4-15s, max 4 images / 3 videos / 1 audio) | seedance2.0-fast-md (10/15s, max 4 images / 3 videos / 1 audio) | seedance2.0-pro (10/15s, max 9 images / 3 audios, no videos) | seedance2.0-fast-pro (10/15s, max 9 images / 3 audios, no videos). Fast I2V: seedance2.0-fast-i2v (per-task, 720p, image refs only). STD standard: seedance2.0-std (per-task, 720p). Seedance 2.0 933: seedance2.0-933 (per-second by resolution; billing names seedance2.0-933-480p/-720p/-1080p). Seedance 2.0 GZ 720p: seedance2.0-gz-720p (per-second, fixed 720p; max 9 images / 3 videos / 3 audios; audio requires image or video refs). Seedance 933 720p: sd2-933-720p (per-second 0.0479/s, fixed 720p; max 9 images / 3 videos / 3 audios)

prompt.description: Text prompt. MD route: max 5000 characters

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Full 4-15; SP economy 4-15; seedance2.0-md 4-15; seedance2.0-fast-md / seedance2.0-pro / seedance2.0-fast-pro: 10 or 15 only; STD standard 4-15. Default 5

resolution.description: Output resolution. For SP economy: 720p (default), 1080p; 480p not supported. Mini also supports 480p

orientation.description: Video orientation (ratio takes precedence if set)

images.description: Reference images. Full route: asset://{assetId}; SP/MD/STD/Fast I2V: https:// URL. seedance2.0-md / seedance2.0-fast-md max 4; seedance2.0-pro / seedance2.0-fast-pro / seedance2.0-fast-i2v / STD max 9. Mutually exclusive with first_image/last_image. seedance2.0-gz-720p: https:// or asset://, max 9

ratio.description: Aspect ratio. MD: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 only. STD: 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Full route also supports 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, Adaptive

first_image.description: First frame. Full: asset://{assetId}; Economy/MD: https:// URL. MD frame mode requires last_image as well; first frame only is not supported

last_image.description: Last frame. Full: asset://{assetId}; Economy/MD: https:// URL. MD frame mode requires first_image as well

reference_videos.description: Reference videos. Full: asset://{assetId}; Economy/MD: https:// URL. seedance2.0-md / seedance2.0-fast-md max 3, combined duration ≤15s, combined size ≤200MB, each resolution 720px–2160px. seedance2.0-pro / seedance2.0-fast-pro / seedance2.0-fast-i2v not supported. seedance2.0-gz-720p max 3

reference_audios.description: Reference audio. Supported on Full, SP economy, and STD. seedance2.0-md / seedance2.0-fast-md max 1 clip; seedance2.0-pro / seedance2.0-fast-pro max 3 clips and must be paired with images; seedance2.0-fast-i2v not supported. Full: asset://{assetId}; SP/MD: https:// URL. Frame mode does not support audio references. seedance2.0-gz-720p max 3 and must pair with images/videos

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio alias (used by seedance2.0-933; takes precedence over ratio). 933 supports 21:9/16:9/4:3/1:1/3:4/9:16

face_processing.description: seedance2.0-933 only. Enable face processing. Default true

generate_audio.description: seedance2.0-933 only. Generate audio. Default false

reference_mode.description: seedance2.0-933 only. Reference mode. Default image

model.description: Model name (supported: gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, nano-banana, nano-banana-2, nano-banana-pro, doubao-seedream-5-0-pro)

images.description: Reference image URLs or base64 strings. doubao-seedream-5-0-pro: max 10; per image: jpeg/png/webp/bmp/tiff/gif/heic/heif, aspect ratio [1/16,16], sides >14px, ≤30MB, pixels ≤6000×6000

resolution.description: Image resolution. doubao-seedream-5-0-pro: 1k, 2k (default 2k), 4k not supported. gpt-image-2, nano-banana-2, etc.: 1k, 2k, 4k. Note: gpt-image-2 with 4K only supports aspect ratios 16:9 / 9:16 / 2:1 / 1:2 / 21:9 / 9:21.

quality.description: Image quality (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1.5). Supported values: low, medium, high, auto.

background.description: Background mode (gpt-image-1.5): auto / opaque / transparent. Use png with transparent.

cost.description: Billed amount for this task (JimiCoin). Uses per-user custom unit price when configured in the console.

model.description: Request model: veo_3_1_fast / veo_3_1_fast-4k, or veo_3_1_lite (720p only).

first_frame_url.description: URL of the first frame image

last_frame_url.description: URL of the last frame image

cost.description: Billed amount for this task (JimiCoin). Uses per-user custom unit price when configured in the console.

video_url.description: URL of the generated video (Valid for 3 days)

image_url.description: URL of the generated image (for image tasks, Valid for 3 days)

cost.description: Billed amount for this task (JimiCoin). Uses per-user custom unit price when configured in the console.

asset_ids.description: List of asset IDs to query

status.description: Audit/activation status (e.g., Active means ready for use)
NONE / UPLOADING / PROCESSING / ACTIVE / FAILED / EXPIRED / DELETED. Only ACTIVE can be used for video generation

model.description: Model name. grok-imagine-video-1.5, grok-1.5, and grok_1_5 normalize to grok-imagine-video-1.5.

prompt.description: Text prompt for video generation. Up to 4000 characters.

ratio.description: Video aspect ratio (e.g., 16:9, 9:16). Takes precedence over orientation.

orientation.description: Video orientation. Active only when ratio is empty: landscape maps to 16:9, portrait maps to 9:16.

image_urls.description: Reference image URL list. grok-imagine-video-1.5 requires exactly 1 reference image.

images.description: Compatibility field for common OpenAPI image inputs; used when image_urls is empty. Requires exactly 1 image.

prompt.description: Text prompt for video generation. 1–2000 characters.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Supports 3–15. Defaults to 6.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Takes precedence over ratio.

example.prompt: A cinematic product shot with natural lighting

model.description: Super-resolution model. Clarity tier: 720p/1080p/2k/4k; lowfps=30FPS, highfps=120FPS.

video_url.description: Public URL of the source video; must remain accessible while the task runs.

model.description: Digital human model name. Default: digitalHuman.

audio_url.description: Public URL of the driving audio. Supported: mp4, mp3, wav, m4a, etc. Avoid non-ASCII characters in the URL; must remain accessible while processing.

video_url.description: Public URL of the face video. Avoid non-ASCII characters in the URL; must remain accessible while processing.

model_version.description: Model version. 1: clearer teeth for large-face shots; 2: better lip sync and faster articulation (recommended).

side_face.description: Side-face optimization. Set 1 for strong side profiles; omit or 0 otherwise.

tilted_face.description: Tilted-face optimization. Set 1 when the face is frontal but tilted / mouth skewed; omit or 0 otherwise.

video_url.description: Public URL of the source video. Avoid non-ASCII characters in the URL; must remain accessible while processing.

model.description: Model name. Gemini-Omini, Omni-Flash-Ext, and gemini-omni normalize to Gemini-Omini; omni-10s is a fixed 10s model (720p, up to 7 reference images).

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Default: 6. Only supports: 4, 6, 8, 10. Note: duration is not required when uploading a reference video, and duration and video_urls cannot be passed at the same time.

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio, for example 16:9 or 9:16. Takes precedence over orientation.

orientation.description: Video orientation. Used only when aspect_ratio is empty: landscape maps to 16:9, portrait maps to 9:16.

image_urls.description: Reference image URL list. omni-10s supports up to 7 images.

images.description: Compatibility field for common OpenAPI image inputs; used when image_urls is empty. omni-10s supports up to 7 images.

generation_type.description: Generation type. frame: first frame mode (image_urls can only accept 1 image as the first frame of the video); reference: reference mode (image_urls can accept 1 or 3 images as style/subject reference). Defaults to reference.

video_urls.description: Reference video URL list (currently supports up to 1 video). Note: duration is not required when uploading a reference video, and duration and video_urls cannot be passed at the same time.
